snippet.title: Introducing the Silly Meter
snippet.description:
Introducing the Silly Meter -- an all new way to play Toontown. After years of work from Toontown's very talented Scientoons, plus some added help from the Fissiontons, the latest invention from Loony Labs is complete!

One thing's for certain: Toontown's about to get a whole lot sillier. Run down to Toon Hall and check out the Silly Meter today! Learn more on the Toontown Blog:
https://toon.town/sillymeter

Learn more and play for FREE at:
https://www.toontownrewritten.com/

Toontown Rewritten is not sponsored or affiliated with The Walt Disney Company and or the Disney Interactive Media Group (collectively referred to as "Disney.") You can learn more from the Lawbots on our website.
